items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Topics 76:1
items.html: (to the question) There is a phase of the ascent of the NHY to the HGT, meaning the ascent of the lights; and then the Partzuf becomes lacking in GAR, for the light of Nefesh ascends to the HGT and the light of Ruach to the HBD, as stated at the time of the birth of ZA, that the light of the NHY ascends to the HGT and the NHY are cooled. And there is an ascent of the NHY to the HGT from the phase of the vessels — that is, through the illumination of the coupling of AB and SAG, which bursts to the Parsa and brings down the bottom Hey from the Einayim and returns the AHP to the degree, at which time the NHY become HGT, the HGT become HBD, and he attains new NHY through Ima. (Part 1, Page 144, Item 59).
